coordinate_convention: Implantacao image: x increases toward street at right; y increases toward gate at bottom. Normalized site envelope is x=0..1,y=0..1. Coordinates are approximate image-reading guides, not cadastral dimensions.

tower.form: One tall elongated residential slab; stepped/notched roof footprint, shallow recesses along long elevations, solid pale end walls.
tower.plan_apartment_finals: Five longitudinal apartment pairs, ordered from gate toward planted buffer: 01/02,03/04,05/06,07/08,09/10.
tower.main_facade_balconies: Five repeated full-height balcony stacks arranged as paired stacks near one end, one single stack at middle, paired stacks at other end (2+1+2). Balcony glazing is dark gray/green; horizontal slab lips and pale vertical piers remain visible.
tower.core: A pale beige/off-white opaque vertical shaft projects above the main roof by roughly one to one-and-a-half floor pitches, with one narrow window stack visible on its face. It is offset toward the gate-side pair of balcony stacks, at approximately 0.37 of main face length from gate-side end, rather than exactly centered.

main_facade_screen_landmarks.limitation: Unrectified perspective landmarks; use as camera-view guides and refine against render.

tower.roof: Flat roofs with stepped shallow pale parapets; no pitched roof or decorative crown. Several roof levels reflect the segmented slab footprint.
tower.colors: Warm off-white/ivory main walls, pale warm gray recessed strips, medium charcoal/green-gray vertical balcony backing, dark charcoal window frames, muted beige slab edges.
tower.windows: Small rectangular apartment windows in many straight vertical stacks; several center strips have 1 or 2 narrow window columns. End elevation seen from aerial has small aligned windows and no broad projecting balcony bands.
tower.base: Tower descends to near grade with glazed/covered access and small canopy; landscaped fence and entry structures partly obscure lowest level in street views. No broad multi-storey podium.

site.shape: Long roughly rectangular/trapezoidal lot, street-side edge diagonal in plan; corners softened by sidewalk landscaping.
site.forest_buffer: Dense irregular woodland occupies approximately the upper 25-30% of lot plan, beyond the far end of tower. Preserve substantial mass and irregular canopy variation.
site.parking: Extensive open surface parking. Multiple long drives run parallel to tower, with narrow green/permeable bays, painted stalls and crosswalks. Rows also wrap near the gate-side short end. Accessible stalls are adjacent to the tower on street-side row.
site.street: Rua Joao de Guzzi along right long edge of plan. Wide divided avenue illustrated in street/aerial references; another street borders forest end/corner.
site.gate: Gatehouse in lower-right corner of plan, beside street, toward one short end. Charcoal horizontal canopy, white/light masonry, one raised rectangular charcoal portal at car entrance, metal vertical fences, pedestrian/vehicle access lanes.
site.pool: Pool complex upper-right, between tower/parking and street, immediately beside planted buffer end. Long rectangular blue adult pool, a small blue basin to one side, white deck and changing-room strip at near end.
site.amenity_strip: Landscaped outdoor amenity band runs from pool down street-side edge to gate. Fitness/lounges/picnic lie below pool; orchard/kids area lies further down; two quiosques occupy one elongated grey rectangular roof footprint; playground sits nearest gate.
site.court: No sports court is identified in the 17-item official amenity legend. The elongated grey rectangle marked 05/06 is the pair of quiosques, not a court.
site.water_tank: Circular white tank at upper-left far end, outside main woodland edge beside left parking/service area.

inferences_for_modeling.reasonable_working_units: Parent proposes approximate tower width 12.7m, length 47.7m and 17*2.85m=48.45m body height. Ratios L/W=3.76,H/W=3.82,H/L=1.02 are consistent with the long slab in the sources. Plan outer roof bbox L/W near3.51 differs because bbox includes projections/notches. Use these as proportional working estimates, not official measurements.
inferences_for_modeling.site_dimensions: Scale can be estimated from official site area and approximate marketing-plan boundary, but uncertainty in included sidewalks and curved boundaries propagates to every derived length. Parent polygon pixel coordinates [(42,80),(508,80),(560,132),(656,684),(45,684)] and factor0.145m/px give a broadly consistent ~6960m2 estimate. Do not label inferred side lengths as measured.
inferences_for_modeling.balcony_depth: Keep balcony ledges shallow, roughly 0.7-1.1m at a 12m-width working scale. Full protruding deep balconies would change facade silhouette from references.
inferences_for_modeling.back_elevation: Back-face repetition and precise end-wall window positions are not completely visible; repeating related apartment rhythms is an inference.

priority_recommendations: Build the long stepped slab first. A square tower cannot resemble these sources.
Match 17 rows and five balcony stacks arranged 2+1+2 before detailing windows or trees.
Keep central vertical shaft taller than all roof parapets and model stepped pale roof edges.
Place tower inside parking field, woodland at far end, pool along street-side far end, entry on opposite street-side end.
Use narrow permeable parking strips and repeated painted bays. Do not invent a sports court.
Render one street main-facade camera, one low entry camera, and one high oblique/top camera to compare against the supplied references.
